anchors.paper_title: Whole-brain electrophysiological functional connectivity dynamics in resting-state EEG
anchors.reason: The paper studies general functional connectivity dynamics in resting-state EEG, which is topically related to the dataset but does not describe or introduce this specific dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a 128-channel Amps 300 amplifier (Electrical Geodesics Inc.) at 1000 Hz sampling frequency during resting state. Preprocessing included band-pass filtering (0.5–100 Hz), notch filtering (58–62 Hz), artifact removal, bad channel interpolation, and re-referencing to average. Data were downsampled to 250 Hz. Structural MRI was acquired using a GE MR750 scanner with BRAVO sequence (FOV 240 mm, 180 axial slices).
